steps.verify: Checker compares the mainline HEAD in GitHub Enterprise and passes when it equals the recorded merge commit.

steps.title: Re-run CI on mainline to green in GitHub Actions
steps.sop: The Backend Developer watches the post-merge run and is done when mainline CI is green.
steps.verify: Checker opens the mainline run in GitHub Actions and passes when the post-merge pipeline reports success.

steps.title: Compare the mainline diff to the approved PR diff in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Backend Developer compares commits and is done when no extra commit appears beyond the approved PR.
steps.verify: Checker diffs mainline against the PR in GitHub Enterprise and passes when the commit count plus diff match exactly.

steps.title: Record the merge SHA with the PR number in the release notes in Confluence
steps.sop: The Software Engineer records SHA plus PR number plus approvers with a UTC timestamp.
steps.verify: Checker opens the release notes in Confluence and passes when the entry matches the merged PR.

steps.title: Raise an SDLC-Exception for any branch-protection override in Jira
steps.sop: The Software Engineer logs any admin merge or bypassed check for the Engineering Manager with a 10-business-day review.
steps.verify: Checker searches SDLC-Exception tickets in Jira and passes when every override in the audit log has one with justification.

steps.title: Record the Tech Lead sign-off comment on the merged PR in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Software Engineer obtains the sign-off and is done when the comment is on the merged PR.
steps.verify: Checker opens the merged PR in GitHub Enterprise and passes when the Tech Lead sign-off comment is present.

tasks.taskName: Model pipeline DAG with task dependencies

steps.title: Draft the DAG design diagram in Mermaid under the docs path in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Software Engineer drafts the diagram for the pipeline named on the design ticket and is done when it is committed.
steps.verify: Checker opens the docs path in GitHub Enterprise and passes when the Mermaid diagram exists for the named pipeline.

steps.title: Define a task_id for every task in the DAG definition in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Software Engineer defines each task_id and is done when every modeled task has one.
steps.verify: Checker reads the DAG file in GitHub Enterprise and passes when every task declares a unique task_id.

steps.title: Define the dependency edges for every task in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Data Engineer defines upstream plus downstream edges and is done when every task is wired.
steps.verify: Checker reads the DAG file in GitHub Enterprise and passes when no task is missing its dependency edges.

steps.title: Set the trigger rule on every task in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Software Engineer sets each trigger_rule and is done when none is left to default unintentionally.
steps.verify: Checker reads the DAG file in GitHub Enterprise and passes when every task declares a trigger rule.

steps.title: Set retries on every task in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Backend Developer sets the retries value and is done when every task declares one.
steps.verify: Checker reads the DAG file in GitHub Enterprise and passes when no task lacks a retries setting.

steps.title: Set the SLA on every task in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Data Engineer sets each SLA and is done when every task declares one with an owner recorded.
steps.verify: Checker reads the DAG file in GitHub Enterprise and passes when every task declares an SLA.

steps.title: Validate the DAG parses with zero cycles in Data pipeline orchestrator (Airflow/Dagster/Prefect)
steps.sop: The DevOps Engineer loads the DAG and acyclicity is validated by the scheduler.
steps.verify: Checker opens the DAG in Data pipeline orchestrator (Airflow/Dagster/Prefect) and passes when it parses with zero cycle errors.

steps.title: Reconcile task plus edge counts to the design diagram in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Software Engineer compares the model to the diagram and is done when both counts match.
steps.verify: Checker counts tasks plus edges in GitHub Enterprise and passes when the totals equal the design diagram.

steps.title: Define exactly one completion signal for each terminal task in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Data Engineer defines the completion signal and is done when every terminal task has exactly one.
steps.verify: Checker reads the DAG file in GitHub Enterprise and passes when each terminal task declares a single completion signal.

steps.title: Model external triggers as ExternalTaskSensors with a disposition note in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Software Engineer models each cross-pipeline dependency that cannot be a direct edge and documents the disposition.
steps.verify: Checker reads the DAG file in GitHub Enterprise and passes when every external trigger uses a sensor with a note.

steps.title: Log unresolved cross-pipeline coupling as an SDLC-Exception in Jira
steps.sop: The Software Engineer logs the coupling with the Tech Lead as owner and is done when the ticket is open.
steps.verify: Checker searches SDLC-Exception tickets in Jira and passes when every unresolved coupling has one owned by the Tech Lead.

steps.title: Tag the committed DAG PR with the design-ticket ID in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Software Engineer tags the PR and is done when the design-ticket ID plus UTC timestamp are recorded.
steps.verify: Checker opens the PR in GitHub Enterprise and passes when the design-ticket ID appears in the PR metadata.

steps.title: Record the Tech Lead approval on the DAG design PR in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Software Engineer obtains the review before implementation begins and is done when the approval is recorded.
steps.verify: Checker opens the PR in GitHub Enterprise and passes when the Tech Lead approval appears in the review timeline.

steps.title: Draft the BPMN process flow as diagrams-as-code in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Business Analyst drafts the process flow for the epic in the approved notation and is done when it is committed.
steps.verify: Checker opens the docs path in GitHub Enterprise and passes when the BPMN source file exists for the epic.

steps.title: Draft the data flow diagram as diagrams-as-code in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Solutions Architect drafts the data flow with sequence views and is done when it is committed.
steps.verify: Checker opens the docs path in GitHub Enterprise and passes when the data flow source file exists for the epic.

steps.title: Label every actor role on each diagram in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Business Analyst labels the actors and is done when no lane or participant is unnamed.
steps.verify: Checker renders the diagrams in GitHub Enterprise and passes when every actor carries a role label.

steps.title: Label the classification on every data entity in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Business Analyst classifies each data entity and is done when none lacks a classification.
steps.verify: Checker renders the diagrams in GitHub Enterprise and passes when every data entity shows its classification.

steps.title: Mark the trust boundaries on each diagram in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Solutions Architect marks the boundaries and is done when each diagram shows them.
steps.verify: Checker renders the diagrams in GitHub Enterprise and passes when trust boundaries are visible on each.

steps.title: Draw the error path for every exception case in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Software Engineer models error plus exception paths and is done when each flow covers them.
steps.verify: Checker renders the diagrams in GitHub Enterprise and passes when every flow shows at least one error path.

steps.title: Label every PII data element on the diagrams in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Business Analyst labels each PII element and is done when none is unlabeled.
steps.verify: Checker renders the diagrams in GitHub Enterprise and passes when every PII element carries the label.

steps.title: Map every epic requirement to at least one flow step in Confluence
steps.sop: The Business Analyst updates the requirements matrix and is done at 100% traceability.
steps.verify: Checker opens the matrix in Confluence and passes when every requirement row maps to a flow step.

steps.title: Verify every system in the flows exists as a CI in CMDB
steps.sop: The Solutions Architect checks each touched system and is done when all resolve to inventory records.
steps.verify: Checker looks up each flow system in CMDB and passes when every one resolves to an existing CI.

steps.title: Mirror the rendered diagrams to the epic page in Confluence
steps.sop: The Business Analyst mirrors the renders and is done when the epic page shows the current versions.
steps.verify: Checker opens the epic page in Confluence and passes when the rendered diagrams match the committed sources.

steps.title: Log open assumptions in the RAID register with owners in Confluence
steps.sop: The Business Analyst logs each assumption with an owner plus target resolution date before design sign-off.
steps.verify: Checker opens the RAID register in Confluence and passes when every open assumption carries owner plus target date.

steps.title: Record the reviewer sign-off date on the rendered epic page in Confluence
steps.sop: The Business Analyst records the review sign-off and is done when the page shows version plus sign-off date.
steps.verify: Checker views the epic page in Confluence and passes when the sign-off date is present on the current version.

tasks.taskName: Monitor pipeline run status and SLA breaches

steps.title: Expose the last-run status for every pipeline on the dashboard in Grafana
steps.sop: The Software Engineer wires the status panel and is done when every in-scope pipeline reports a status.
steps.verify: Checker opens the dashboard in Grafana and passes when 100% of in-scope pipelines show a last-run status.

steps.title: Expose duration against SLA for every pipeline on the dashboard in Grafana
steps.sop: The Data Engineer wires the duration panel and is done when each pipeline shows runtime versus its SLA.
steps.verify: Checker opens the dashboard in Grafana and passes when every pipeline panel shows duration against SLA.

steps.title: Expose the queue depth for every pipeline on the dashboard in Grafana
steps.sop: The Data Engineer wires the queue-depth panel and is done when each pipeline reports it.
steps.verify: Checker opens the dashboard in Grafana and passes when every pipeline shows a live queue-depth series.

steps.title: Set the SLA warn threshold at 80% of the window in Grafana
steps.sop: The Software Engineer sets warn at 80% with breach firing at 100% of the SLA duration.
steps.verify: Checker opens the alert rules in Grafana and passes when the warn threshold reads 80% and breach reads 100%.

steps.title: Set the queue-depth warn alert above 50 pending in Grafana
steps.sop: The Software Engineer sets warn above 50 pending with critical above 200 tuned to keep false positives under 5%.
steps.verify: Checker opens the alert rules in Grafana and passes when warn fires above 50 and critical above 200 pending.

steps.title: Attach the runbook link to every alert rule in Grafana
steps.sop: The Data Engineer links each runbook with on-call routing and is done when no rule lacks one.
steps.verify: Checker opens each alert rule in Grafana and passes when the runbook link resolves.

steps.title: Version the alert ruleset in the monitoring-config repo in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Software Engineer commits the ruleset and it must be approved before activation with the version tagged.
steps.verify: Checker opens the monitoring-config repo in GitHub Enterprise and passes when the active ruleset matches the tagged version.

steps.title: Source SLA targets from the criticality-tagged service records in CMDB
steps.sop: The Data Engineer pulls SLA targets from the catalog and no hard-coded value may live outside the config repo.
steps.verify: Checker opens the service records in CMDB and passes when every monitored pipeline's SLA matches its catalog entry.

steps.title: Reconcile expected to actual run counts per schedule in Data pipeline orchestrator (Airflow/Dagster/Prefect)
steps.sop: The Data Engineer reconciles schedules and is done when missed runs equal zero for the period.
steps.verify: Checker compares schedules to run history in Data pipeline orchestrator (Airflow/Dagster/Prefect) and passes at zero missed runs.

steps.title: Route every failure alert to an auto-created incident in ServiceNow ITSM
steps.sop: The Software Engineer wires the integration so each failed run or breach opens an incident routed to the on-call Data Engineer.
steps.verify: Checker samples failure alerts in ServiceNow ITSM and passes when each has an auto-created incident with severity set.

steps.title: Escalate unresolved P1 incidents after 30 minutes in ServiceNow ITSM
steps.sop: The Production Support Engineer escalates to the Platform Engineering Lead when a P1 stays unresolved past 30 minutes.
steps.verify: Checker reviews P1 incident timelines in ServiceNow ITSM and passes when every over-30-minute P1 shows the escalation.

steps.title: Verify every failure alerts within 60 seconds over a 7-day window in Grafana
steps.sop: The Software Engineer observes a 7-day window and every failure or breach must alert within 60 seconds.
steps.verify: Checker compares failure timestamps to alert timestamps in Grafana and passes when no alert lagged beyond 60 seconds.

steps.title: Raise a P2 monitoring-gap incident for any silent failure in ServiceNow ITSM
steps.sop: The Production Support Engineer raises the incident and the alert rule must be fixed within 2 business days.
steps.verify: Checker searches monitoring-gap incidents in ServiceNow ITSM and passes when every silent failure has one with a root cause.

steps.title: Record the Platform Engineering Lead approval on the ruleset PR in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Software Engineer obtains the approval before the ruleset activates and is done when it is recorded.
steps.verify: Checker opens the ruleset PR in GitHub Enterprise and passes when the Platform Engineering Lead approval appears.

steps.title: Publish the consumer-lag series for every prod topic in Grafana
steps.sop: The Data Engineer exposes lag per topic to the dashboard and is done when every prod topic reports it.
steps.verify: Checker opens the health dashboard in Grafana and passes when every prod topic shows a live consumer-lag series.

steps.title: Publish the partition-skew series for every prod topic in Grafana
steps.sop: The Data Engineer exposes partition utilization per topic and is done when every prod topic reports it.
steps.verify: Checker opens the health dashboard in Grafana and passes when every prod topic shows a partition-skew series.

steps.title: Publish the end-to-end latency series for every prod topic in Grafana
steps.sop: The Software Engineer exposes latency per topic and is done when every prod topic reports it.
steps.verify: Checker opens the health dashboard in Grafana and passes when every prod topic shows an end-to-end latency series.

steps.title: Flag topics missing any required metric red on the health dashboard in Grafana
steps.sop: The Software Engineer wires the completeness rule and a topic missing a required metric shows red.
steps.verify: Checker reviews the dashboard in Grafana and passes when every metric-incomplete topic renders red.

steps.title: Bind at least one alert rule to each telemetry series in Grafana
steps.sop: The Site Reliability Engineer binds alerts evaluating on 1-minute windows and is done when no series is unbound.
steps.verify: Checker opens the alert rules in Grafana and passes when each lag plus skew plus latency series has a bound rule.

steps.title: Set the sustained consumer-lag alert at 10,000 messages in Grafana
steps.sop: The Site Reliability Engineer sets the threshold and any 5-minute sustained excess must fire.
steps.verify: Checker reads the lag rule in Grafana and passes when the threshold reads 10,000 sustained messages.

steps.title: Set the p99 latency alert at 5 seconds in Grafana
steps.sop: The Site Reliability Engineer sets the threshold and any 5-minute sustained excess must fire.
steps.verify: Checker reads the latency rule in Grafana and passes when the threshold reads 5 seconds at p99.

steps.title: Reconcile produced counts to landed counts per 15-minute bucket in Enterprise data warehouse/lakehouse
steps.sop: The Data Engineer reconciles within 0.1% tolerance and a sustained breach raises a P2 alert.
steps.verify: Checker runs the bucket reconciliation in Enterprise data warehouse/lakehouse and passes when deltas stay within 0.1%.

steps.title: Run a synthetic lag-injection test on a non-prod topic in Event streaming platform (Kafka/Confluent)
steps.sop: The Site Reliability Engineer injects lag and the bound alert must fire within its evaluation window.
steps.verify: Checker reviews the test topic in Event streaming platform (Kafka/Confluent) and passes when the injected lag triggered the alert.

steps.title: Version the dashboard JSON under the observability path in GitHub Enterprise
steps.sop: The Software Engineer commits the dashboard JSON and is done when the deployed dashboard matches the repo.
steps.verify: Checker opens the observability path in GitHub Enterprise and passes when the committed JSON matches the live dashboard.

steps.title: Route each threshold breach to a streaming-pipeline incident in ServiceNow ITSM
steps.sop: The Software Engineer wires auto-creation and a disposition is recorded on each incident before closure.
steps.verify: Checker filters streaming-pipeline incidents in ServiceNow ITSM and passes when every breach shows one with a disposition.

steps.title: Escalate unrecoverable lag past 30 minutes to a P1 in ServiceNow ITSM
steps.sop: The Site Reliability Engineer escalates to the Software Engineer with the consumer-group offset snapshot attached.
steps.verify: Checker opens the P1 incidents in ServiceNow ITSM and passes when each carries the offset snapshot attachment.

steps.title: Record the Site Reliability Engineer sign-off on the telemetry dashboard in Grafana
steps.sop: The Site Reliability Engineer signs off when lag plus utilization plus latency are live for every prod topic with 90-day retention.
steps.verify: Checker opens the dashboard annotations in Grafana and passes when the sign-off is recorded with a date.

tasks.taskName: Obtain QA sign-off on release candidate

steps.title: Pin the release candidate to an immutable build tag in GitHub Actions
steps.sop: The DevOps Engineer tags the exact artifact and every suite run must tie to this build SHA.
steps.verify: Checker opens the pipeline run in GitHub Actions and passes when the RC artifact carries the immutable version tag.

steps.title: Confirm zero open blocker or critical defects on the release in Jira
steps.sop: The Test Lead runs the release defect query and unresolved blockers veto sign-off.
steps.verify: Checker re-runs the release query in Jira and passes when open blocker plus critical counts both read zero.

steps.title: Confirm coverage of at least 80% on changed lines in SonarQube
steps.sop: The Software Engineer reviews the coverage report and is done when changed-line coverage is at or above 80%.
steps.verify: Checker opens the RC analysis in SonarQube and passes when changed-line coverage reads 80% or higher.

steps.title: Confirm coverage of at least 90% on critical paths in SonarQube
steps.sop: The Software Engineer reviews critical-path coverage and is done when it is at or above 90%.
steps.verify: Checker opens the RC analysis in SonarQube and passes when critical-path coverage reads 90% or higher.

steps.title: Confirm the full regression suite passes on the RC build in GitHub Actions
steps.sop: The QA Analyst runs the fully automated regression suite and zero new failures versus the prior baseline are allowed.
steps.verify: Checker opens the regression run in GitHub Actions and passes when 100% of tests are green against the RC build SHA.

steps.title: Confirm zero critical or high SAST/DAST findings in SonarQube
steps.sop: The Software Engineer reviews the security scans and at most 5 medium findings with waivers are tolerated.
steps.verify: Checker opens the security report in SonarQube and passes when critical plus high counts read zero.

steps.title: Confirm performance stays within 10% of the baseline in Apache JMeter / k6 Performance Testing
steps.sop: The QA Analyst runs the benchmark against the RC and is done when results sit within 10% of the established baseline.
steps.verify: Checker opens the benchmark report in Apache JMeter / k6 Performance Testing and passes when no metric drifts beyond 10%.

steps.title: Reconcile planned to executed test cases at zero delta in Jira
steps.sop: The QA Analyst reconciles mandatory suites and is done when planned versus executed delta equals zero.
steps.verify: Checker compares the test plan to execution records in Jira and passes when the mandatory-suite delta reads zero.

steps.title: Attach the UAT sign-off to the release in Jira
steps.sop: The Test Lead attaches the business UAT confirmation and is done when it is on the release record.
steps.verify: Checker opens the release in Jira and passes when the UAT sign-off attachment is present.

steps.title: Log each waived finding as an SDLC-Exception with justification in Jira
steps.sop: The Test Lead logs each waived defect or accepted medium finding for the Engineering Manager on a 10-business-day SLA.
steps.verify: Checker searches SDLC-Exception tickets in Jira and passes when every waiver carries a business justification plus owner.

steps.title: File the QA sign-off evidence package in GRC platform (Archer/ServiceNow GRC)
steps.sop: The Test Lead exports the exit-criteria evidence named qa-signoff with release plus date and it is retained 7 years.
steps.verify: Checker opens the evidence store in GRC platform (Archer/ServiceNow GRC) and passes when the package carries the build SHA plus signature.

steps.title: Link the release change record to the build tag in ServiceNow ITSM
steps.sop: The DevOps Engineer links the change record to the immutable tag plus the evidence ID.
steps.verify: Checker opens the change record in ServiceNow ITSM and passes when it references the build tag and the QA evidence ID.

steps.title: Document the go/no-go decision in the readiness minutes in Confluence
steps.sop: The Test Lead records Approved or Conditional or Rejected with the residual-risk statement plus any conditions.
steps.verify: Checker opens the readiness minutes in Confluence and passes when the decision plus recipient list are recorded.

steps.title: Record the Test Lead sign-off on the release in Jira
steps.sop: The Test Lead signs off as an approver independent of the change author with delegation logged when absent over 1 business day.
steps.verify: Checker opens the release in Jira and passes when the sign-off names an approver who is not the change author.
